name: cable standing cross-over high reverse fly
description: A standing cable reverse fly that crosses over at the end. You open the arms out and back to hit the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Set both pulleys high with a handle on each and stand in the middle.
Take the left handle in your right hand and the right handle in your left, so the cables cross in front of you.
Start with your arms crossed in front of your chest, elbows slightly bent.
Sweep your arms out and back to the sides at shoulder height, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly to the crossed position.
